# opnsense_dnsmasq_range (Data Source)

Dnsmasq DHCP ranges (**Services ▸ Dnsmasq DNS & DHCP ▸ DHCP ranges**) for DHCPv4 pools and DHCPv6 / router advertisements.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the dnsmasq DHCP range.

### Read-Only

- `constructor` (String) Interface whose IPv6 prefix the range is built from (DHCPv6 only).
- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `domain` (String) Domain handed out to clients of this range.
- `domain_type` (String) Whether `domain` applies to this range or to the whole interface.
- `end_address` (String) Last address of the range.
- `interface` (String) Interface the range is served on, e.g. `lan`.
- `lease_time` (Number) Lease time in seconds.
- `mode` (Set of String) Range flags; `static` only serves static reservations.
- `no_sync` (Boolean) When enabled, this range is not synchronised to an HA peer.
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length for DHCPv6 ranges.
- `ra_interval` (Number) Router advertisement interval in seconds.
- `ra_mode` (Set of String) Router advertisement flags.
- `ra_mtu` (Number) MTU announced in router advertisements.
- `ra_priority` (String) Router advertisement priority; unset means normal.
- `ra_router_lifetime` (Number) Router lifetime announced, in seconds.
- `start_address` (String) First address of the range.
- `subnet_mask` (String) Subnet mask handed out, when it differs from the interface.
- `tag` (String) UUID of the tag set on clients that get an address from this range.
